title: Set up the system
description: First-run setup: a few steps and the system is ready for your organisation.

token.intro: For security, setup needs the one-time setup token printed in the application log when the system started.
token.where: Find it in the log of the app container (docker compose logs app) or run the application with --setup-token to print a new one.
token.label: Setup token
token.invalid: This setup token is not valid. It may have expired or been replaced: print a new one with --setup-token.

organisation.codeHint: Letters and digits, e.g. ADOF. Used in record numbers and as the code of the top unit.

branding.logoLater: Logos can be uploaded later in Settings → Branding.

languages.defaultLanguageHint: Used until each person chooses their own language. Both languages are always available.
languages.hijriHint: Off by default; data always stays Gregorian.
languages.digitsHint: Numbers show as ١٢٣ in the Arabic interface.

administrator.intro: The first administrator manages the whole system. Two-step verification is set up at the first sign-in.

done.title: The first administrator is ready
done.description: Sign in as {{email}}. After setting up two-step verification you continue with the guided configuration.

configure.title: Guided configuration
configure.description: Configure the essentials now or skip any step and do it later in Settings.

hints.email: Set the outgoing mail server and send a test e-mail. Without it, nobody receives notifications or invitations.
hints.authentication: Optional: sign-in with Entra ID, ADFS, SAML, LDAP or UAE Pass. Local accounts always work.
hints.ai: Optional: AI assistance stays off until a provider is configured and switched on. Use Test connection before enabling it.
hints.calendar: Working days and hours drive every deadline and SLA. Add the public holidays of the year.
hints.import: Download the templates, fill in your units and then your employees, and upload them.
hints.systems: Choose which systems are enabled. Disabled systems are hidden for everyone.
hints.demo: Optional, for presentations only: load sample users and records in every system. They can be removed later.
hints.finish: You can come back to this wizard from Settings → Setup wizard until you finish it.

configure.forbidden: Only administrators can run the setup wizard.

demo.passwordHint: All demo users sign in with this password. Never use demo data in production.
